assertions.text: Resolves the repository_policy.provider_profile (and confirms it maps to git-kit) before discovering gates
Discovers gates from actual repository configuration sources named in the skill (pre-commit config, branch protection, workflow files), not a hardcoded universal list
Never asserts a 'Review Changes' gate exists unless real repo config names one
If branch protection can't be read, discloses this as ambiguous (permission vs. absence) rather than concluding 'no protection'
